P.text: executeHedge() is called with PM active; it buys the spot asset on L1 and unconditionally registers it in the accountant's vaultSupplied registry via notifyVaultSupply, with no check that BLP has an active reserve for the token
P.evidence_quote: When `executeHedge()` is called with PM active, it buys the spot asset on L1 and immediately registers it in the accountant's `vaultSupplied` registry via `notifyVaultSupply`

I.text: BLP must have an active reserve for the token for HyperLiquid to auto-supply the spot asset to BLP; otherwise the token should not be recorded as supplied
I.evidence_quote: Under PM, HyperLiquid auto-supplies spot assets to BLP only if a BLP reserve exists for that token.

V.text: If no reserve exists, auto-supply silently does nothing on L1 but EVM state records the token as supplied; _readL1Backing later queries 0x811 via suppliedBalance, which reverts for a never-supplied token, propagating through totalBackingSigned, surplus, distributableSurplus, and settleDailyPnL gate 3, permanently bricking accounting reads and yield settlement until an operator calls removeSuppliedEntry
V.evidence_quote: On HyperEVM, querying 0x811 for a token that was never actually supplied to BLP produces a failure response. This causes `suppliedBalance` to revert.
